caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed against a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is predominantly gray, with a smooth, slightly reflective surface, and features a rounded body, a wide, flared mouth, and a sturdy handle attached to one side. Decorative elements in vivid cobalt blue are painted on the surface of the pitcher, consisting of stylized floral patterns, with large petals, leaves, and curving stems distributed across the front and side, while the handle also has blue accents. The interior mouth of the pitcher is shaded to suggest depth, and there is a subtle shadow beneath the pitcher, anchoring it to the ground. The lower left corner has a small, cursive signature that reads “G. Capelle.”
title: Pitcher
